policy: Seven origin cohorts; adult occupational/royal role assigned once at eighteen; artisan professions rotate across craft, trade, medicine, law and entertainment. One quarter free, three quarters Premium. Canonical career IDs validated, including poacher_job. Reload checkpoints at twelve, thirty and fifty. Two work actions, rest below 75 health, deterministic stated decision policy with hash tie breaks, peaceful RPG resolution. Actual mortality; no invulnerability. Availability sampled only when a cohort survives to the stated age.

history.text: Your cradle travels with a consignment of cloth. Your mother, Constance, keeps you warm in the finest offcuts; your father, Cuthbert, notes that even scraps have a price. A failed shipment leaves the counting house short of cash and in debt.
😈 From the cradle you are Heathen. Skips chapel, questions everything, sleeps fine.

history.text: You arrive during a rent dispute. Your father, Aldric, offers the bailiff a chicken; your mother, Emma, offers him the door. You inherit neither victory nor dry bedding.
